author: Hal Turner
title: Hal Turner Radio Show - DEVASTATING TORNADO TEARS THROUGH SOUTHERN FRANCE
text:
A powerful tornado ripped through Pomas, in France’s Aude village, around 17:05–17:20 on August 24, after a violent supercell produced intense rotation confirmed by radar.
The destruction is staggering: around 300 homes damaged, roofs ripped away, walls collapsed, buildings destroyed, trees uprooted and vehicles overturned. Entire sections of the village were left looking devastated.
39 people were injured, including two in critical condition.
Around 2,800 households lost electricity, with roughly 1,400 still without power the next morning.
Tornado activity is almost unheard of in France.
